LanguageData.LP_Statue_Lathander.label: statue of Lathander
LanguageData.LP_Statue_Lathander.description: A stone statue of the Morninglord holding up a sun disk. When Lathander is the patron deity, placing it on any home map gives the patron deity +0.3 divine favor per day (counted once no matter how many); believers get mood +1 when the culture's god has a statue, -1 when it doesn't. Placed in the same room as an altar it makes a temple: prayers in a temple give ×1.25 divine favor, festivals +10% quality.
